text:
lisa: P1 from customer: hosted generation API returning 502/503 for multiple tenants since ~09:12 UTC. They report ~30% requests fail with gateway errors, latency spikes before failure. Example request id: rq_0b9f3a2c. Customer attached curl and response body.

lisa: sample curl they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","input":"hello"}' -i
```

lisa: response snippet from customer:
```json
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": { "message":"upstream service returned 502","code":502 } }
```

ajay: looking at control-plane metrics now. Routing-policy service error-rate jumped at 09:11 UTC, traces show timeouts to config-db (~1500ms) then 5xx bubbled up.

monica: yep, routing-policy logs show repeating timeouts when fetching per-tenant overrides: `GET /v1/policy/tenant/xyz` -> `TimeoutError: Request timed out after 1200ms`

ajay: heap: config-db connection pool exhausted, latency from pool queueing. I see a recent config deployment at 09:05 that touched a migration on policy indexes — could be related.

jenna: @lisa I have John on the call (customer-john) — he confirmed the errors started right after 09:10 and internal retries didn't help. They're on Dedicated tier but using hosted control-plane.

customer-john: We're seeing spikes across several regions, particularly us-east-1. App-level retries stack up and we hit client 429s too. We need a mitigation ASAP.

sre-oncall: immediate mitigation plan: 1) fail routing-policy to a safe default (no per-tenant overrides) 2) increase config-db client timeout and pool size 3) restart routing-policy instances one at a time. Will coordinate with monica + ajay.

ajay: creating quick patch to fallback to 'global-policy' when config-db lookup fails. Pushing to canary (1 instance) now.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated: routing-policy@canary -> commit 5a7c9d by ajay.

monica: canary started at 09:28 UTC, telemetry shows one instance using fallback. Early signal: error rate for that instance dropped to 0.5% from 18%.

ajay: rolling canary to 4/6 instances. Also increasing config-db client socket timeout from 700ms -> 1500ms as a stopgap.

lisa: customer confirmed some improvement at 09:34, but still seeing intermittent 502s for heavy batch requests.

monica: digging into config-db: we're seeing a slow query on policy table causing connection hold times of ~1200-1800ms. Query plan shows missing index after the migration — likely the recent schema change.

ajay: reverting the migration is risky mid-day. Alternative: add temporary index and tune connection pool. I can open an ops DB patch to add index without full rollback.

jenna: customer wants ETA and asks if we can route them to private control plane temporarily. Not feasible quickly; mitigation on our side preferred.

monica: logged DB patch: `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_policy_tenant ON policy (tenant_id, active)` — will run with low priority. Also increasing max_connections for config-db client from 50 -> 80.

ajay: running index create as concurrent now (09:48). We'll monitor lock/no-lock.

deploy-bot: index create job queued on db-cluster-primary.

lisa: communication update to customer: "We're rolling a safe fallback for routing and applying a concurrent index in config DB. Expect reduced 5xx within ~20-40 minutes; will update in 10 mins." :thumbsup:

customer-john: thanks — appreciate updates. Will monitor, currently error rate down to ~6% from 30%.

monica: index applied successfully at 10:03, observed median policy query p95 dropping from 1200ms -> 80ms. Pool queue length reduced.

ajay: completed rollout of fallback across routing-policy cluster at 10:09; observed platform-wide 5xx drop to <0.3%.

lisa: verifying customer impact: john reports errors cleared for their heavy flows. Moving to incident report and remediation items.

jenna: capturing follow-ups: 1) revert temporary timeout increases after stability 2) review migration process + preflight checks for missing indexes 3) add circuit-breaker so routing-policy doesn't cascade 4) customer facing postmortem + credit. I'll own the customer comms.

monica: ops actions: add integration test to validate policy query patterns and index coverage; add alert for config-db pool queue time > 200ms.

ajay: postmortem note: root cause = schema migration that removed/changed index pattern causing slow config-db lookups -> connection pool exhaustion -> routing-policy timeouts -> control-plane 5xx returned by gateway. Remediation = add concurrent index, increase resilience (fallback), better preflight for migrations, improve runbook.

lisa: tagging this thread for follow-up with eng-runtime and eng-ml since customers hit model-serving pipeline; but root cause was control-plane config DB.

sre-oncall: closing immediate P1 after monitoring 30 minutes of stable metrics. Will keep an eye on alert channel for 2h. :white_check_mark:

lisa: thanks everyone. I'll draft the internal incident summary and include action owners for the list from jenna.

customer-john: thanks team — service appears stable now. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
